Sample Note

Before You Retry, Find Where It Failed

If the client gets no response, the server may still be processing the request, or it may have finished and the response was lost in transit. Both look like timeouts to the client. What happens on retry depends on whether the server already completed the operation.

You can consider automatic retries for reads. For requests that change state, first check whether the server can tell that a retry is part of the same operation. That will inform how you retry.
